_doc: Law L-b on the RECORDED EDLs of the two frozen references, measured 2026-11-12 (session pipeline_pp_tests) with sentence_law.edge_word_bounds (the acoustic word extent edge_fades itself uses; 10 ms grid) on each source around its cut, read-only. in_overlap_ms = (cut_in + fade_in) - first_word_onset; out_overlap_ms = last_word_end - (cut_out - fade_out); > 0 = the recorded fade overlaps the edge word by that much. The references are frozen: this table is their measured state (tests/adversarial/test_f5_references.py pins it; a change in the bytes or in edge_word_bounds fails there). Recorded dispositions: L-b must-fail = the preview's clip_01 OUT (Natalie Brunell '...Monday rally.'); test_edge_words.py's G17c legacy edges of v2f = clip_01 OUT and clip_03 IN. ffmpeg_version: the decoder the table was measured with (a decoder change can move a 10 ms frame: re-measure, do not edit by hand).
